mitrasova-pos.title: Mitrasova POS
mitrasova-pos.heroTagline: Offline-First Cashier POS, Consignment & Automatic Accounting
mitrasova-pos.summary: Fast Cashier System that Works 100% Offline When Internet Drops, with Supplier Consignment Split, Multi-Branch Stock, and Instant Financial Reports.
mitrasova-pos.description: Mitrasova POS is a smart point-of-sale software for retail minimarkets, fashion boutiques, wholesalers, and multi-branch chains. Key advantage: cashiers serve customers with zero lag even when the internet goes down, automatically calculate supplier consignment revenue splits, sync stock across branches, and generate automated P&L reports.

features.title: Cashier Keeps Working When Internet Goes Down
features.description: No need to panic during network outages. Cashiers scan barcodes, accept payments, and print receipts without interruption. All sales sync automatically once internet reconnects.

features.title: Manage Consignment Stock & Supplier Revenue Share
features.description: Organize consigned items cleanly. Store commissions calculate automatically upon checkout, complete with return slips and periodic supplier settlement invoices.

features.title: Automatic Financial & Profit/Loss Reports
features.description: Every sale records automated accounting journals, gross profit, and inventory balances. Check your store profitability anytime from your smartphone.

features.title: Monitor Multi-Branch Stock & Print Fast Receipts
features.description: Track stock levels across all branches and warehouses, transfer inventory between stores, print thermal receipts over Bluetooth/LAN, and manage cashier shift handovers cleanly.

faqs.question: Can Mitrasova POS manage consignment (titip jual) supplier stock?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Mitrasova POS has a dedicated consignment module to track supplier records, calculate revenue share splits upon sale, monitor remaining stock, and generate settlement invoices.

faqs.question: If the store internet goes down, can cashiers still checkout customers?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%! Mitrasova POS is built on an Offline-First architecture. Cashiers scan barcodes, process payments, and print receipts with zero latency. When internet restores, all transactions sync automatically to central servers with zero duplication.

faqs.question: What financial reports are automatically generated by Mitrasova POS?
faqs.answer: Daily sales summaries, profit and loss (P&L) statements, balance sheets, inventory movement logs, cashier shift reports, and supplier consignment payout invoices.

mitrasova-daya.title: Mitrasova Daya
mitrasova-daya.heroTagline: HRIS, Automated Payroll & Employee GPS Attendance App
mitrasova-daya.summary: Streamline HR & Payroll: Calculate Salaries & Statutory Taxes in 1 Click, Selfie GPS Attendance Anti-Buddy Punching, and Mobile Leave Approvals.
mitrasova-daya.description: Mitrasova Daya makes managing staff effortless for HR and business owners. Manage rotating shift rosters for stores or plants, calculate complete payslips with statutory tax brackets and social security in 1 click, and track employee attendance through verified selfie photos and precise GPS locations.

specs.label: Attendance Check
specs.value: Accurate GPS Geofence & Liveness Face Check

specs.label: Payslip Delivery
specs.value: Automated Encrypted PDF via WhatsApp & Email

features.title: Calculate Payroll & Statutory Taxes in 1 Click
features.description: Say goodbye to complex Excel formulas. Base salaries, overtime, allowances, statutory taxes, and social security deductions calculate automatically in seconds.

features.title: Selfie GPS Attendance (No More Buddy Punching)
features.description: Employees clock in from their phones with selfie verification within defined workplace geofence radiuses. Protected against fake-GPS spoofing.

features.title: Dedicated Employee Mobile App (Leave & Payslips)
features.description: Staff submit sick leaves, annual vacations, reimbursement claims, and download monthly payslips directly from their smartphone.

features.title: Flexible Shift Roster Management for Retail & Plants
features.description: Easily organize morning, afternoon, and night shift rotations. Overtime hours automatically reflect on monthly payslips.

faqs.question: Are tax formulas compliant with statutory regulations?
faqs.answer: Yes! The computation engine is continuously updated in accordance with the latest statutory tax regulations, saving you from manual tax bracket headaches.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for businesses with dozens to hundreds of employees?
faqs.answer: Very suitable. Mitrasova Daya is flexible for growing businesses with a dozen staff up to large enterprises with thousands of employees and multiple branches.

mitrasova-nexus.heroTagline: High-Speed, Secure & Fully Managed Cloud Server Hosting
mitrasova-nexus.summary: Reliable Managed Cloud Server with Guaranteed 99.99% Uptime SLA, Advanced Anti-DDoS Protection, and 24/7 Monitoring Support.
mitrasova-nexus.description: Mitrasova Nexus is a managed cloud server hosting solution for your websites, cashier systems, and company databases. Hosted in Tier-4 facilities in Jakarta & Singapore to ensure ultra-fast access, protection against cyber threats, and 24/7 proactive monitoring.

features.title: Protected from Cyber Threats & DDoS Attacks

features.title: Automated Daily Backups & Rapid Recovery

features.title: Flexible Server Scaling as You Grow

faqs.question: Where are the physical servers located?
faqs.answer: Our servers are hosted in Tier-4 certified facilities in Jakarta (Indonesia) and Equinix Singapore to ensure the fastest connectivity across Southeast Asia.

faqs.question: If we encounter a technical server issue, is support available?
faqs.answer: Yes, our technical engineers monitor server health 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year with rapid response SLAs.

features.title: Weekly Progress Reports & Post-Launch Warranty

faqs.question: How long does it take to develop a custom software application?
faqs.answer: Timelines depend on complexity. Mid-sized applications typically require 4–8 weeks, whereas complex integrated enterprise systems take 2–4 months with phased sprint milestones.

faqs.question: Will our company own 100% of the source code and Intellectual Property?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%! Upon handover, all source code repositories and IP rights belong exclusively to your company with no hidden recurring licensing fees.
